pr_title: Needed for #25132: Fix `X509_PURPOSE_add()` to take `sname` as the primary key
pr_body:
As discussed in #25873, `X509_PURPOSE_add()` should not take `id` but the `sname` string for checking if the entry already exists.

Fixing this needed to take into account that the design of `STACK_OF(X509_PURPOSE) *xptable` in `v3_purp.c`
is pretty bad regarding identification and has its pitfalls. 
In particular, the `purpose` identifier is redundant with both the table index and with the `sname`. It must be unique, but the list of identifiers is not necessarily ordered and without gaps.
Made sure that the fix retains backward compatibility with this and with the - undocumented - behavior of `X509_PURPOSE_add()` when a new purpose entry (with a fresh `sname` and `id`) is added.

This PR also adds the missing documentation and thorough tests for the `X509_PURPOSE` API.
 
On this occasion, this PR also includes a related fix, namely on `X509_PURPOSE_set()`,which currently is part of https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/25132/files#diff-aed28e7e6b851f4d02d1d60c190cd1d8584012f98aca7c4210eb6dc3272792d7R105)
The function must to allow for `purpose == 0` in order to enable  `X509_VERIFY_PARAM_set_purpose()` to reset to the default (any) purpose.

pr_comments: I do not think this should go into stable branches.
Also there is a semantic change of the return value - I'm worried about this. Should we rather add X509_PURPOSE_add_ex() with this semantics and keep the existing function as is?

> Also there is a semantic change of the return value - I'm worried about this. Should we rather add X509_PURPOSE_add_ex() with this semantics and keep the existing function as is?

In my view the change is backward compatible in the sense that it still returns nonzero on success,
yet I see the point that this may be risky (callers might check for == 1).
Instead of adding `X509_PURPOSE_add_ex()`, I'm going to revert this part of the changes,
by carving that part out into a function just for finding a free purpose id. This is also more flexible.

BTW, I'll add numerous API test calls on `X509_PURPOSE_add()` and friends...
Thank you @DDvO for the the fix. LGTM.

> I do not think this should go into stable branches.

Yeah, it's likely not worth the headache which parts of this PR should/could be backported,
even regarding the API documentation finally filled in, as this API appears very rarely used so far.
Yes, I definitely think it is appropriate.

Asking again @openssl/committers for 2nd review.
This fix is needed for continuing with the feature PR #25132 to be included in 3.5.

Thank you @t8m and @beldmit for your reviews and approvals.

As requested, I added to the doc a caveat regarding thread-safety.
Since this invalidated your approvals, please re-confirm.
This pull request is ready to merge
Merged - thanks again for the helpful reviews.

issue_context.title: X509 `v3_purp.c`: unsuitable identification of existing entries in `xptable` (for dynamically added purposes)
issue_context.body:
Hi,
In my recent feature pull request (#25132), I am using `X509_PURPOSE_add()`. 
It uses purpose `id` to look for the existing entry, if not present then create a new one.
In my view, instead of id, `sname` should be used because for dynamic purpose id is just a next free index, which will always be unique. 

https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/b9881e8eb1962607a3a920347c4cad6e2566727c/crypto/x509/v3_purp.c#L170-L173

My suggestion will be use `X509_PURPOSE_get_by_sname()` for checking the existing entry.
comments:
So you want to say that the `X509_PURPOSE_add()` function should not use the purpose ID but the purpose (short) name to check whether the purpose to be added is already present? I agree.

Also more generally, for user-defined entries the purpose ID is volatile, so cannot really be used to identify a purpose.
Using the purpose short name would be a much better, safe basis.
Not only for checking the existence of a purpose, but also for later addressing/selecting it.
@t8m @vdukhovni - could you please review the issue as it is blocking the PR #25132.

review_comments: Can using this function cause a thread  issue? You want to register purpose ids dynamically, right?

Yes, `X509_PURPOSE_add()` and (therefore also its new helper function `X509_PURPOSE_get_unused_id()`) is about adding new purposes to a static structure potentially shared among threads,
and strictly speaking this can suffer from race conditions.

This inherent problem with `X509_PURPOSE_add()` has been pre-existing for the X509_PURPOSE mechanism, and this PR is not aiming to solve it.
Looks like nobody has been caring about this problem because hardly anyone uses this API.
Therefore I believe it is very unlikely that an actual thread issue will occur.
May I ask you to document this issue (in a separate PR if you think it's better)?

Since this PR anyway adds respective doc to  `X509_check_purpose.pod`,
I've added the following section there:
```
=head1 BUGS

The X509_PURPOSE implementation so far is not thread-safe.
There may be race conditions retrieving purpose information while
X509_PURPOSE_add() or X509_PURPOSE_cleanup() is being called.
```
